title: Multi-structure conserving hydrologic response ensemble program registry
purpose: Broaden hydrologic structures while preserving total-flow accuracy, mass conservation, spatial transfer tests and bounded model-response claims for TN.
allowed_dynamic_evidence: PML V2.2a monthly AET soft target
Q-derived FDC, recession, low-flow, autocorrelation and BFI response signatures
forbidden: TN observations in hydrologic fitting or selection
Gauge/P2 station-history correction in the 230-Reach product
station identity or terminal-tree random intercepts
unproven nationwide 1-km groundwater-level raster in fitting
calling response components observed groundwater, new water, old water or water age
